name: main
sql: SELECT Title AS title, RepositoryName AS repo, BlockedOnUserMs / 60000 AS wait_min FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 7) AND BlockedOnUserMs > 0 ORDER BY wait_min DESC LIMIT 5

name: total
sql: SELECT sum(BlockedOnUserMs) / 60000 AS total_min FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 7)
